newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Xpress to offer for 3.4 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Xpress to offer for 3.4 mln shares.

text.p: U.S. Xpress Enterprises Inc said Thursday it intends to file a statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission on behalf of it and selling stockholders for a proposed offering of 3.4 million Class A shares.
The company said it will offer 2.5 million shares and selling stockholders, co-chairmen Patrick Quinn and Max Fuller and the Quinn Family Partnership, will offer 900,000 shares.
The company said underwriters have been granted a 30-day option to buy up to 510,000 additional shares to cover over-allotments, if any.
The offering is being underwritten by underwriters led by Alex. Brown & Sons Inc and including Morgan Stanley Dean Witter, Morgan Keegan & Co Inc and Schroder & Co Inc.

The company said it expects the offering to the public to begin no later than early August. It said it plans to use proceeds to buy revenue equipment now financed under operating leases and to reduce indebtedness.
It said it will not receive any of the proceeds from the sale of shares by the selling stockholders.
